name: conversation-thread-key
description: One channel thread key joined to one conversation: the adapter's business identity for the thread (provider + remote thread id) naming the conversation it opened or joined. The first key opens the thread; every later key for the same customer joins it and leaves one row here, so a retried open under a joined key replays the joined thread instead of opening a duplicate — including after the thread closed. Every field is managed: a thread key exists only through the interactions package's open path, and no client can create, forge or rewrite one.
